subtitle: Out Manila · Cebu Pacific
overview: Visit the three classic Kansai cities of Osaka, Kyoto and Nara on a private-coach tour with an English-speaking guide. Highlights include Fushimi Inari Shrine, Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Todaiji Temple and Deer Park, with free time for shopping in Shinsaibashi and Dotonbori and a free day for an optional Universal Studios Japan visit. Fly Manila – Osaka and back with Cebu Pacific; stay in 3–4-star hotels.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Mar 12–16 2027 to Mar 28–Apr 1 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Osaka Castle: A reconstructed 16th-century castle in Osaka, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Fushimi Inari Shrine: A Kyoto shrine famous for its thousands of red torii gates winding up a mountain.
placeDesc.Arashiyama Bamboo Grove: A path through tall bamboo in Arashiyama, western Kyoto.
placeDesc.Shinsaibashi: A major Osaka shopping arcade, explored on your own in the evening.
placeDesc.Dotonbori: Osaka's lively canal-side entertainment and street-food district.
placeDesc.Todaiji Temple: A Nara temple housing a giant bronze Buddha, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Nara Deer Park: A park in Nara where tame deer roam freely among the temples.
placeDesc.Rinku Premium Outlets: An outlet shopping centre near Kansai Airport, visited on the last day.
placeDesc.Universal Studios Japan: A theme park in Osaka offered as an optional tour on the free day.
